# Fixture Lighthouse Keeping Manual

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Lamp Maintenance

The lamp of the fixture lighthouse must be cleaned every evening before sunset.
Keepers record each cleaning in the lamp register.

### 1.1 Wick Trimming

Wicks are trimmed to a height of 4 millimetres. A wick trimmed too short produces a dim beam;
a wick left too long produces soot on the lens.

### 1.2 Lens Polishing

The keeper polishes the lens with a dry chamois cloth. Abrasive powders are not permitted on the lens.

## 2 Logbook Rules

Every watch must be logged with:

- the time the watch started
- the weather observed
- any vessel sighted

Entries are written in permanent ink and are never erased.

## 3 Storm Procedure

During a storm the keeper stays in the lantern room. The fog signal sounds every 30 seconds while
visibility is below 2 kilometres.
